title: Suggested pauses from allowance limits and activity gaps
goal: The report proposes pauses the agent confirms
acceptance: Report lists `suggestedPauses` per job: an allowance bucket at 100 % until its `resetsAt` or the next activity, and gaps without events, phases or snapshots longer than `workUsage.pauseGapMinutes` (default 15)
A suggestion is never subtracted until recorded with `pause`
work-usage.md says to check the suggestions when finishing a job
privacy: Ledger metadata and invented fixtures only; no transcripts or personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: two detectors over data the ledger already keeps, a setting and tests. Not a measurement.
